page.notes: The Greek word after "tamen eorum" and the Hebrew word "בדו" after "in" are hard to read; the scan is blurred. The Hebrew line "נוסיף על דברי אלהים חיים" is partly obscured by printed boxes and may be misread. The third Hebrew line is set in the same line as "licet". The page number "522" is uncertain (the first digit could be 3). The catchword "fidero" is blurred; it may be "sidero" with a long s, the end of the word "confidero" after "con-". The printed "tria, propter spicas" has a small mark between the words, which I did not transcribe.
